name: Workbench
duplicates: Old UI (Figma 首页 › 工作台) has the same list as a default and an all-expanded state, plus Select language, Log out and an operation-result screen; none of those three are built in the prototype.
flow: tap the section name in the header
tap a task card that has no detail page (Pregnancy check)

notes.purpose: The first screen of the app: what needs doing now in the worker's section, task by task across all its units.
states: Overview scope (no unit chosen) in the Farrowing section, mixed work: Farrowing live and due (active), Piglet processing waiting under "Next", one closed Piglet processing receipt.
Offline at start: saved-work card at the top with 3 records waiting.

URL params read by the page: section (breeding|gestation|farrowing|nursery), view (sections|overview|unit), unit, work (mixed|active|waiting|round-complete|ready), attention (current|clear|health|feed|maintenance|busy|unknown). `layout=focus` is not read by Home itself; it is only forwarded to the detail pages Home opens.

elements.name: Header · farm label
elements.logic: Static uppercase label above the section name; there is no farm switch.

elements.name: Header · section name
elements.logic: The current section's name with a chevron. On first load the section is the URL `section` when valid, else the last section the worker picked (localStorage key sentri-home-prototype-section), else Gestation. Tapping opens the section chooser.

elements.name: Header · Assistant
elements.logic: Door to the Assistant page (a separate space; findings and chat live there, not on Home).

elements.name: Scope rail · Overview
elements.logic: Pressed when no unit is chosen. Tapping it clears the unit and shows the section's tasks across all units.

elements.name: Scope rail · Choose unit
elements.logic: Second button. Label is "Choose unit" with no unit chosen, "Unit N" with one. The small figure is the number of units in the section (Farrowing: 6, 7, 8; Gestation 7, 8, 9; Breeding 1-4; Nursery 12, 13). Tapping opens the unit picker.

elements.name: Saved-work card
elements.shows: 3 records saved on this device · No connection · waiting to upload
elements.logic: The offline banner. While records are waiting (sync.pending.length > 0) it sits at the top under the scope rail; title is "N records saved on this device" (or "Uploading N records"), the subtitle follows the connection: "No connection · waiting to upload", "Connection available · tap to upload", "Upload interrupted · tap to retry", "Sending saved work…". With nothing waiting it moves to the bottom of the list as "All records uploaded · No records waiting on this device". The page starts offline with 3 sample records.
elements.source: sync{} and pendingExamples in home-astra-prototype.js (fictional; no real queue)

elements.name: Today's work heading
elements.logic: One heading anchors the list; the date is fixed sample text, not today's date.

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · title
elements.logic: The task type of the instance (tasks[].type).

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · batch line
elements.logic: Batch name, then a fixed context phrase for the task (cardFields.farrow28.context). Does not change with the unit chosen.

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · timing pill
elements.logic: Clock icon and "Day N of N" for the batch window (cardFields day, days); "Today" when the window is one day. Contextual timing only, never a completion measure (HOME-TASK-DISPLAY-RULES). Shown on every open card except the ready-to-complete state; in a unit scope an arrow follows it.

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · headline count
elements.logic: Farrowing rule 1: recorded farrowing underway. Value = sows whose record is flagged active within the scope (sample rule: the next unrecorded sow in each unit except Unit 8). Overview 2 (Units 6 and 7), Unit 6: 1, Unit 7: 1, Unit 8: none. Label takes the singular for 1 ("1 sow farrowing").

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · supporting line
elements.logic: Rule: while farrowing is underway, one supporting line: "N past expected date" if late, else "N due today". Home never supplies a late count, so only the due-today line appears. Value = sum of cardFields.farrow28.due over the scope ({6:2, 7:2, 8:0}). With no live sow, due today becomes the headline ("4 sows due today") with no supporting line; with nothing due, a quiet line "Next expected · Tomorrow" replaces the block.

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · progress
elements.logic: Named aggregate progress: sows with a recorded result over all sows in the scope. Overview 7/18 (Unit 6 4/8, Unit 7 1/6, Unit 8 2/4). Bar width = value/total. Home forces the bar to a plain completion bar (the distribution bar with farrowed/active/awaiting lives in the task).
elements.source: metric(t, unit); records Map built from tasks[].counts

elements.name: Task card · Farrowing · footer
elements.logic: Overview only. "Across N units" = the number of units that carry this task (Object.keys(counts).length), not units with work due. In a unit scope the footer is replaced by the arrow in the header and the action is "Open unit task".

elements.name: "Next" sub-heading
elements.logic: Printed once above the first quiet card (waiting, round-complete or upcoming). Open cards sort by attention rank: live farrowing/alert 0, overdue 1, due 2, ready to complete 2.5, waiting 3 (earliest next event first), closed 4; equal ranks keep their order.

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · title and batch
elements.logic: Same slots as every card. Batch 27 (not the 40 the opened prototype shows).

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · timing pill
elements.logic: Batch window position (cardFields day 3, days 7); not the litters' own age. The rules warn litter age and task age must not be conflated.

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · quiet line
elements.logic: Rule 2 (next scheduled care) in the quiet style under a "Next" sub-heading. The card is forced to the waiting state (cardFields.piglet27.state = "waiting") so the sample due counts {6:2, 7:2} are ignored; nextAt 1440 prints "Tomorrow". Earlier times print as hh:mm.

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · when care is due
elements.logic: Seen with ?work=active. Rule 1: litters with at least one scheduled care item due and unfinished; count unique litters. Value = sum of cardFields.piglet27.due. No supporting line is supplied (the rule would show litters with overdue required care).

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · progress
elements.logic: Whole-schedule progress, not today's work: pens with a result over pens in the scope (measure "pens"). Unit 6 1/4, Unit 7 0/4.

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · footer
elements.logic: Units 6 and 7 carry the task. Tapping the card leaves Home for the piglet-processing prototype (simple/index.html) with layout, from, section, entry (and unit, returnUnit in a unit scope) in the URL; that page reads none of them.

elements.name: Closed tasks heading
elements.logic: Heading with the count of closed instances in the scope (completedAt or terminatedAt set).

elements.name: Closed task card
elements.shows: Piglet processing · Batch 26 · Across 3 units · Completed · Today, 09:10
elements.logic: Closed tasks collect at the bottom under "Closed tasks N" as a compact receipt: check icon (stop icon and "Ended early" when terminated), title, batch (and scope in the overview), completion stamp. Never revived with due counts. Tapping opens the read-only receipt page.

elements.name: Bottom navigation
elements.logic: Home is active; Scan opens a scan drawer; Toolbox opens the tool list. Both are outside this feature.

controls.does: leaves Home for the Farrowing prototype's whole-task overview (entry=overview)
leaves Home for the piglet-processing prototype
opens the Assistant page (outside this feature)
opens Scan drawer / Toolbox page (outside this feature)

copy: (raw) every string on Home is literal in home-astra-prototype.js and astra-home-task-card.js; none uses ux/laws/strings.json yet
edge: A section with no tasks shows the quiet empty state (Nursery).
Unit scope hides the footer and shows the arrow; a unit without the task hides its card.
Closed tasks never show due counts; they sort last.
If localStorage is blocked the remembered section is simply not used.
rules: Shared evaluation order: closed receipt, confirmed exception, task-specific work due, all required recorded, unit work complete, next scheduled action.
Main count = actionable now; bar = named aggregate progress. "Day N of N is contextual timing, not a completion measure."
Counts are unique animals or litters in the selected scope.
issues: unclear: `layout=focus` has no effect on Home; it only matters when Home opens a detail page.
The date "Thu, 8 Jul" is fixed sample text while the piglet-processing prototype uses the real clock.
"Across 3 units" counts units that carry the task, not units with work due, and repeats on every card in the overview.
Piglet processing card mixes litters and pens: "4 litters with care due" (with ?work=active) next to a bar of "1 / 8 pens". A pen is a litter in the opened prototype.

The Piglet processing card says care is due tomorrow (Batch 27, 8 pens, 2 units) but the prototype it opens starts on Batch 40 with 12 pens and 6 pens due today. Home passes unit and section; the prototype ignores them.
The saved-work card sits at the top of the list as a permanent first card while offline, pushing the day's work down; the queue it shows is fictional.
The screen has no way to reach language or log out (the old Figma has them).

notes.purpose: Pick one unit of the section to narrow every count to that unit.
states: How to reach: open the Overview and tap "Choose unit"; no URL param opens it.
A medium-height drawer over the dimmed Overview; the current unit (when there is one) is marked with aria-current on its row.

elements.name: Drawer title
elements.logic: Section name + " units".

elements.name: Count line
elements.logic: All units of the section are listed, including units with no tasks; around 15 units is the stated maximum so there is no search.

elements.name: Unit row · title
elements.logic: "Unit " + id.

elements.name: Unit row · description
elements.logic: Pigs and pens of the unit. In the Farrowing section the pig and pen figures are overridden (Unit 6: 8 pigs, 4 pens; Unit 7: 7 pigs, 4 pens; Unit 8: 4 pigs, 2 pens) so they match the Farrowing prototype.

elements.name: Unit row · trailing
elements.logic: Number of open tasks in the section that have unrecorded rows in this unit (remaining(unit): not closed, rows without a result > 0), or "No tasks". Waiting tasks count if they have unrecorded rows, so it can disagree with the cards the unit screen shows.

elements.name: Footer
elements.logic: Closes the drawer and returns focus to the Choose unit button.

controls.does: sets the unit, updates the URL (view=unit&unit=N) and returns to Home in that unit's scope

copy: (raw) Farrowing units · All 3 units · Unit 6 · 8 pigs · 4 pens · 2 tasks · Back
edge: Units with no tasks still appear, with "No tasks".
Focus is trapped in the drawer; Tab cycles.
rules: "The picker has no search" (about 15 units at most).
Unit selection narrows counts, not batch time.
issues: "2 tasks" counts tasks with unrecorded rows, which includes waiting tasks, while the unit screen shows only cards for tasks that carry the unit and a "Next" group; the label does not say what it counts.
unclear: the direction doc says the selected unit has a muted tint and a checkmark; the picker code only sets aria-current, and whether the row component draws it was not checked.

notes.purpose: A quiet view across the farm to choose where to work.
states: `?view=sections` or tap the section name in the header. Four sections: Breeding, Gestation, Farrowing, Nursery. The current one is marked with a check, others an arrow.

elements.name: Page title
elements.logic: Page heading with the farm name as subtitle.

elements.name: Intro
elements.logic: Static helper text.

elements.name: Section card · title
elements.logic: Section name with its symbol; check on the current section.

elements.name: Section card · population
elements.logic: Units in the section and a fixed pig population per section.

elements.name: Section card · work
elements.logic: Number of distinct task types in the section with unrecorded rows (pendingTypes); "No scheduled work today" when 0 (Nursery). Waiting tasks with unrecorded rows count as "ready".

elements.name: Footer note
elements.shows: Work is shared with your team. Your section selection changes the view for you.
elements.logic: Static.

elements.name: Bottom navigation
elements.logic: Home is active; Scan opens a scan drawer; Toolbox opens the tool list. Both are outside this feature.

controls.does: switches section, clears the unit, remembers the section locally, goes to its Overview

edge: A section with no scheduled work still opens, to a quiet empty state.
rules: "Selecting a section opens its Overview. Remember the last section."
issues: "task types ready" counts waiting tasks as ready; it says nothing about work due now.
The footer note and intro repeat the choice the cards already make.

notes.purpose: The same Overview in a section that shows every kind of card state at once.
states: Active: Pregnancy check Batch 31 "5 sows ready to check · 7 scheduled later", progress 8 / 20 sows.
Quiet group under "Next": Return-heat check "Round complete · Next check · 14:30" (no bar); Pregnancy check Batch 32 "Next checks · Tomorrow", 0 / 8 sows.
Closed: Pregnancy check Batch 29 receipt.
Tapping a card opens the "not designed yet" task preview (no detail page exists for these tasks).

elements.name: Task card · Pregnancy check · headline
elements.logic: Pregnancy rule 1: checks whose window is open (sum of cardFields.preg31.due {7:2, 8:2, 9:1}).

elements.name: Task card · Pregnancy check · supporting line
elements.logic: Rule: overdue → due rechecks → scheduled later; only the first applies. Here: unrecorded sows (12) minus due (5).

elements.name: Task card · Return-heat check · quiet line
elements.logic: Observation task with an explicit "round complete" preview state (cardFields.return30.state). No progress bar, per the rule "no Home progress bar for return-heat". Only explicit activity may mark a round complete.

elements.name: Task card · Pregnancy check Batch 32 · timing pill
elements.logic: Window of one day prints "Today" in the pill even though the card says the next checks are tomorrow.

elements.name: Closed task card
elements.shows: Piglet processing · Batch 26 · Across 3 units · Completed · Today, 09:10
elements.logic: Closed tasks collect at the bottom under "Closed tasks N" as a compact receipt: check icon (stop icon and "Ended early" when terminated), title, batch (and scope in the overview), completion stamp. Never revived with due counts. Tapping opens the read-only receipt page.

elements.name: "Next" sub-heading
elements.logic: Printed once above the first quiet card (waiting, round-complete or upcoming). Open cards sort by attention rank: live farrowing/alert 0, overdue 1, due 2, ready to complete 2.5, waiting 3 (earliest next event first), closed 4; equal ranks keep their order.

controls.control: A task card without a detail page

edge: Observation tasks (heat, return-heat) have no progress bar on Home; Heat check shows "Recorded in heat" as an outcome bar instead.
rules: Return-heat: "No Home progress bar, return-rate result or elapsed-time bar."
Heat: recorded-in-heat is an outcome, not completion.
issues: Batch 32 shows "Today" in the pill and "Next checks · Tomorrow" in the body.
Heat check in Breeding shows "20 sows to check" and "0 / 20 sows" recorded in heat: the same 20 twice.

notes.purpose: Shows the Overview when every task has work due now.
states: `work=active` forces due counts on cards that are waiting by default: Piglet processing becomes "4 litters with care due". Other `work` values: waiting, round-complete, ready (see workbench.all-recorded). The same choice is a select outside the phone ("Work preview").

elements.name: Task card · Piglet processing · headline
elements.logic: Sum of cardFields.piglet27.due ({6:2, 7:2}); label from displayRules.piglet.label; singular "litter with care due" for 1.

rules: "Count unique litters, not the number of procedures."
issues: The "Due now" status label exists only in the card's accessible name; visually the pill still says "Day 3 of 7".

notes.purpose: Shows the cards that are ready to be completed by the worker.
states: `work=ready`: cards with a completion bar fill to total and show "All required work recorded" and a "Review & complete task" row; the timing pill and footer are hidden. Tasks without a bar (heat, return-heat) are unchanged ("10 sows to check · Current round").

elements.name: Task card · quiet line
elements.logic: Ready state: facts.readyToComplete, only when no closure dependency (closureBlockedBy is not set in Home; "Waiting for X to close" exists in the card code but is not exercised).

elements.name: Task card · call to action
elements.logic: Shown instead of the footer on a ready card. Whole-task closure stays global, not scope-dependent.

edge: A full bar never proves readiness on its own; the rules require dependencies to be checked (not simulated here).
rules: "A full outcome bar, one full treatment session or a finished unit does not prove whole-task readiness."
issues: The dependency wait ("Waiting for farrowing to close") is coded but no sample reaches it.

notes.purpose: What the Overview shows when a section has no task today.
states: Empty state with a check mark: "No scheduled tasks today", then "Select a unit to inspect pens or record anything you find." and a Tomorrow card.

elements.name: Empty state
elements.logic: Shown when the scoped task list is empty. In a unit scope the text becomes "You can still inspect this unit and record anything you find." and the Tomorrow card is hidden.

elements.name: Tomorrow card
elements.shows: Tomorrow · Growth check · Batch 26 · Units 12–13 · sample weights
elements.logic: Static sample text, Overview only.

edge: Units 12 and 13 still have environment and device access.
issues: The Tomorrow card is hard-coded text, not derived from any task.

notes.purpose: The same Home narrowed to one unit: its facts, its entrances (inspect, environment) and only its tasks.
states: `view=unit&unit=N`. `attention` changes the attention chips (current, clear, health, feed, maintenance, busy, unknown); a select outside the phone does the same.

elements.name: Scope rail · Overview
elements.logic: Pressed when no unit is chosen. Tapping it clears the unit and shows the section's tasks across all units.

elements.name: Scope rail · Unit
elements.logic: Replaces "Choose unit"; the unit picker reopens from it.

elements.name: Unit hub · Inspect unit
elements.logic: Entrance to the Inspection prototype for this unit. Pigs and pens come from units{}.

elements.name: Unit hub · Checked
elements.logic: First segment of units[N].checked (the part before the name); date and checker are sample data.

elements.name: Unit hub · attention chips
elements.logic: Chips only for signals above zero. Health and Feed are fictional snapshot counts chosen by the attention preview; Maintenance = open maintenance records of the unit. When all are zero: "No flagged items"; when unknown: "Health and feed summary unavailable".

elements.name: Unit hub · Environment & devices
elements.logic: Present only if the unit has at least one numeric reading or one device; shows readings, or "N devices" when there are none. Absent in all Farrowing and Breeding units of the sample.

elements.name: Task cards
elements.shows: Pregnancy check · 2 sows ready to check · 2 scheduled later · 2 / 6 sows
elements.logic: Same cards as the Overview with the unit's figures; the footer is replaced by the arrow; tasks without the unit are hidden.

elements.name: Coming up
elements.logic: Collapsed card listing next batches/rounds for the unit (Batch 31 Pregnancy check Next round · tomorrow; Batch 30 Return-heat Next round · 14:30). Not shown in the Farrowing section.

controls.does: opens the Inspection prototype with this unit
opens the unit's maintenance list (the row only exists when a unit is chosen)

edge: A unit with no readings and no device has no environment card.
Attention counts of "unknown" are shown as unavailable, never zero.
rules: "Unit context belongs at the entrance." "Inspection owns the pen walk; Unit Home owns population, last check, environment/device access and maintenance."
issues: The same Health 3 / Feed 3 snapshot appears in every unit.
The Maintenance count is a chip inside the Inspect card, but tapping it opens Inspection, not Maintenance; the list is only reachable via Toolbox. A handler `unit-fault` exists with no control.
"Checked Yesterday" drops who checked and when; the direction doc says the strip shows last-check time.

states: Farrowing "1 sow farrowing · 2 due today · 4 / 8 sows"; Piglet processing quiet "Next care · Tomorrow", 1 / 4 pens. Unit 8: Farrowing quiet "Next expected · Tomorrow", 2 / 4 sows, no Piglet card.

notes.purpose: Shows what is saved on the phone and not yet sent, and lets the worker upload it.
states: How to reach: tap the saved-work card. The state is picked with the "Connection preview" select outside the phone (not in the URL): No signal · 3 pending (default), Connected · ready to upload, Upload fails · retry needed, All records uploaded.

Offline: "3 records waiting to upload" + "No connection · check Wi-Fi or mobile signal"; button "Upload 3 records"; pressing it offline reports "Still no connection. All 3 records remain on this device."
Uploading (0.9 s): button "Uploading…" disabled, message "Uploading saved records…".
Failed: "Upload did not complete. Your records are still on this device. Try again." with "Retry upload".
Done: "Everything is uploaded", "There are no records waiting on this device.", button "Done".

elements.name: Summary
elements.logic: Count of sync.pending; icon is the offline icon when there is no connection, otherwise upload; a check when empty.

elements.name: Connection line
elements.shows: No connection · check Wi-Fi or mobile signal
elements.logic: From sync.connection.

elements.name: Record row
elements.logic: Title, context and save time of a queued record. Three fictional samples; nothing the other screens do feeds this queue.

controls.does: simulated upload; clears the queue only on success

edge: A failed upload keeps every record.
Only a successful upload clears the queue and moves the card to the bottom.
rules: "Distinguishes records saved on this device from records uploaded for the team."
issues: The offline queue is entirely simulated: records made in the other prototypes never appear here.
unclear: where the old Figma data-sync list/detail (数据同步) fits relative to this drawer.

elements.name: Title and subtitle

elements.name: Body

elements.logic: Static message. The research docs call this the "Not designed yet" page; the code says "Task preview".

elements.name: Footer

controls.does: returns to Home with scope restored
